tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: One Sparkflights fare by the numeric id from search_deals: its itinerary, the price text of its fare page, its outbound and return flights, the date pairs its fare page lists with their prices, and its url, route_url and feed_url. A fare that is no longer live returns an error naming its route page.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search the current flight fares on Sparkflights, ranked by cost per mile against each market's limit. Each deal is available now and shows when its price was last checked; an empty result means no current fare matches, not that no flights exist. Each deal has the price text of its Sparkflights fare

tools.name: watch_route
tools.description: The Sparkflights page that saves a fare watch for a route: url opens the watch form with both cities and the cabin filled in. A watch covers every airport of both cities. Saving it needs a free Sparkflights account.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_deals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
